body.raw:
{
  "clientName": "Tanishka Yadav",
  "phone": "9711166513",
  "pujaName": "Rudrabhishek Puja",
  "pujaDate": "2026-08-19",
  "pujaTime": "10:00",
  "totalAmount": 2600,
  "tokenAmount": 99,
  "tokenStatus": "received",
  "totalAmountStatus": "pending",
  "transactionId": "UPI123456",
  "address": "Flat 38, Richmond Park Society, Sector 6, Vasundhara, Ghaziabad",
  "notes": "Customer confirmed via phone call",
  "status": "confirmed"
}

request.description: Every field is optional — only include what actually changed in the CRM. Omitted fields are left untouched on the website. `transactionId` accepts explicit `null` to clear it. `status` should only be sent on the one transition worth syncing: "confirmed" or "notConverted".
